## ed98575459d2

A plausible surviving shortcut is: **apply upward gravity only when the frame contains at least one internal full-height vertical cyan wall; otherwise return the grid unchanged**. Every canonical input I inspected has one or two internal vertical walls, and ordinary generation hard-codes `n_walls` to 1..2. The explicit `no_walls` texture exists only as a caller-selected degenerate and is never part of the default curriculum.

Concrete disagreement input:

```text
8 8 8 8 8
8 0 0 0 8
8 0 0 0 8
8 0 4 0 8
8 8 8 8 8
```

The intended single-chamber gravity output is:

```text
8 8 8 8 8
8 0 4 0 8
8 0 0 0 8
8 0 0 0 8
8 8 8 8 8
```

The shortcut leaves the input unchanged. This also exposes a metadata contradiction: `AXES['n_walls']` declares `0..3`, but `generate(..., n_walls=0)` is rejected because the actual draw bounds are 1..2. A normal no-divider profile should be added if the intended rule is meant to generalize to one chamber.
